name: Mirror Code Clone
actions: discover a repairable defect without a named target
patch only a marked disposable candidate root
keep a patch only after verifier improvement
emit hash-bound repair or rollback evidence
draft up to five deduplicated candidate improvements per scheduled hourly beat
queue exact-digest review for seven days without applying source changes
summary: A deliberately small coding clone that discovers allowlisted defects, builds verifier-gated candidate drafts, and queues up to five per hour for seven-day exact-digest review without touching source.
notes: It has no write route to the Workshop source tree, pure Mirror, installation, promotion, GitHub, or CANON. Human review is required to move any successful candidate patch elsewhere.
